title: MISP contains an access control flaw in its tag management endpoints: events/addTag (single and… (CVE-2026-132642)
description: MISP has an access control vulnerability in its tag management endpoints allowing authenticated users with tagger role or host-organisation membership to enumerate tags on hidden events and modify tags on events and attributes they cannot see. The flaw stems from unscoped database queries that bypass ACL visibility checks. The issue affects endpoints for adding and removing tags on events and attributes. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.3.
